neighbours.label: the verb (mostly ' has') right after a bare noun subject naming a substance or activity in science writing (Alcohol has, Sleep has, Hunting has)
fire: Researchers agree that caffeine has a measurable effect on alertness.
In older adults, exercise has been linked to better memory.
Over the last decade, smoking has declined sharply in most countries.
Clinicians note that aspirin has been used for over a century.
In several trials, fasting has improved insulin sensitivity.
Field studies show that grazing has reduced plant diversity on the hills.
For many patients, stress has a strong influence on blood pressure.
Recent work suggests that meditation has benefits for chronic pain.
quiet: Researchers agree that a cup of coffee in the morning helps alertness.
In older adults, regular walks seem linked to better memory.
Over the last decade, fewer people in most countries smoke.
Clinicians note that doctors prescribed aspirin for over a century.
In several trials, patients who fasted improved their insulin sensitivity.
Field studies show fewer plant species on heavily grazed hills.
For many patients, a stressful job raises blood pressure.
Recent work suggests benefits for chronic pain from daily meditation.

notes: card only; peak tokens ' has' x6, ' is' x3 after bare-noun subjects in health/science prose
